name: Aurum PropTech Limited
summary: Aurum PropTech Limited engages in the business of software development for real estate and other services in India. It operates through Rental, Distribution, Capital, and Others segments. The company provides HelloWorld, a co-living platform for students and young professionals; Nestaway, a home rental platform that offers residences in prime urban locations; and MonkSpaces.Ai, which enables real estate businesses to monetize and manage their rental portfolios.
